body:
CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real cross-platform CI: new .github/workflows/ci.yml builds apps/client + apps/mapeditor for Linux (native gcc), Windows (mingw-w64 cross-compile), and macOS (native clang, Homebrew SDL2), uploading each as a GitHub Actions artifact, gated behind a real bazel test //... run. apps/server stays Linux-only, excluded by design. Fixed 3 real cross-platform bugs surfaced along the way: a Windows include-order bug (winsock2.h vs GL/gl.h's own windows.h), a Windows mkdir() argument-count compile error in packages/common/papercraft_worldobjects.h (new PC_MKDIR macro), and a macOS GL header path gap (OpenGL/gl.h vs GL/gl.h). Verified via real local raw-gcc and raw-mingw-gcc dry-runs matching the workflow's exact commands, plus a full clean bazel build/test (27 targets, 12/12 tests pass). macOS job itself unverifiable locally (no macOS host in this environment) -- honestly flagged in NORTHSTAR.md/README.md. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
